description: This file defines a test discovery utility for a PyTorch project, locating Python and C++ test files, filtering based on blocklists and extra tests, and generating a sorted list of test identifiers.

methods.name: parse_test_module
methods.description: Extracts the base name of a test module from a filename string.

methods.name: discover_tests
methods.description: Discovers and filters test files (Python and C++) based on provided blocklists and extra tests, returning a sorted list of test identifiers.
